passage: Subject: My School Presentation Hi Alex, How are you? I just finished my big history presentation at school, and I wanted to tell you about it. I worked really hard on it, and my teacher said it was well-made. I compared my project with others in the class, and I think mine stood out because I used a lot of pictures. My grandpa helped me with some research. He’s very patient and gave me good advice. I had to present in front of the whole class, but I didn’t feel embarrassed because I practiced a lot. I could easily explain my ideas. Next week, I’m getting my diploma for completing the course. I’m so excited! Maybe we can celebrate together. Let me know how your projects are going. Best, Sam
